objective: Prespecified multi-repository first-authentic-native-failure admission followed by existing byte-frozen developmental method inventory; prospective heldouts unopened unless training method passes causal gate.

eligibility: PR merged, full original base/head SHAs and title beginning fix or bugfix case-insensitively
exactly one production-like .py changed, neither generated nor test/doc/samples/examples/scripts/benchmarks
exactly one author-test-like .py changed, tests/test/ directories or basename test_*
no .github/workflows, packaging configs, project dependency requirements/lock changes
same external repository must not be used as AnyIO/attrs/tox/Trio/Pluggy prospective training or earlier exposed method role
no PR body/patch/commit diff/source/test contents before pool freeze

pool.first_native_eligible_rule: Visit five frozen TRAINING candidate slots in order; first original-base+HEAD-test-overlay with >=1 executed newly added or changed author-protected assertion FAIL, no collection/setup error, and no protected skip is TRAINING; stop; any absence/app-error retained; do not peek at future bodies
pool.future_rule: Freeze two other repository slots by metadata only; no future clone/test until verified training method and withdrawal-restoration pass; choose first frozen future, second remains preserved as untouched backup only per frozen eligibility, no outcome-based swap

install_order: first available PEP735 test/tests group, project test/tests/dev extra, existing test-requirements.txt/requirements-test.txt in frozen priority
native_admission.test_selector: AST diff changed author head test against base, prefer newly added/modified Test* method or top-level test_* function; exact nodes; no unsupplied test invention
native_admission.require: >=1 executed protected FAIL, 0 errors, 0 protected SKIP, original source pinned, no passing inferred from import failure
native_admission.environment_error: UNKNOWN_APPARATUS, continue predetermined pool only; original outcome retained

methods.constraint: qualified source algorithm function bytes and candidate grammar immutable, no new repair-specific variant after reading training; no manual winning patch; outputs must pass original native author protected and full relevant file, physical withdrawal and cold restart

comparators.strong_agent: Only if an actually executable equally informed coding-agent runtime is available; otherwise explicit NOT_RUN and G4 UNKNOWN
comparators.budgets: charged setup/search/native calls/candidate logs/verifier/cold restart/transfer; no free baseline access

permissions: read-only external repos; write only isolated owned heathsanchez/test branch; all future external source sealed until admission plus training causal gate
lineage: AnyIO observed native causal repair qualified but retrospective

stopping: At first failed scientific gate stop; archive exact UNKNOWN/negative. Preserve all historical records. Never claim G2 from training-only result.
